branchName.instructions: Use lowercase kebab-case prefixed by change type: fix/<slug>, feat/<slug>, perf/<slug>, docs/<slug>, or chore/<slug>.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits (fix/feat/perf/docs/chore/ci, optional scope like feat(seo):, fix(audio):, or fix(games):) with a concise imperative subject explaining what changed and why.

pullRequest.instructions: Summarize root cause and fix concisely, list verification commands run (npm test, npm run test:runtime-deps, npm run build, audit-pidgin-app.js), respect the Kimo-only voice rule (f0ODjLMfcJmlKfs7dFCW) and /sw.js cache headers, and include Verify-After: <delay> | <check> when post-deploy live verification is needed.
